rows.en: Touya: "Come to think of it, Aurelie went straight back
to her room... She really means to cook, huh?"
Touya: "Huh? Yamato? Not again..."
Yamato: "I'm back!"
Touya: "Did Aurelie catch you again?"
Yamato: "Yes. But this time, she just asked me to deliver a message."
Touya: "A message?"
Yamato: "You know, that meal she promised us.
It's ready, so she wants us to come to her room."
Touya: "She could've come herself... Or used the communicator."
Yamato: "Oh, what's the problem? Let's go enjoy the food."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "It's me..."
Aurelie: "Oh, come in."
Touya: "Excuse us... Oh, that smells good."
Aurelie: "Welcome!"
Yamato: "It smells wonderful."
Aurelie: "...Of course. I put all my skill
into making it."
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "Hm? What's wrong?"
Touya: "Nothing... You just look different from usual..."
Aurelie: "I'm cooking. Of course
I'd dress like this. Anyway..."
Touya: "Ohhh, it looks delicious.
Did you make all of this yourself?"
Aurelie: "If you don't believe me, shall I explain
how to make every dish from scratch?"
Touya: "...I'll pass."
Yamato: "Hey, Aurelie, what's this dish?
It looks like a gratin..."
Aurelie: "Oh, that? It's called bonne femme.
It's a classic home-style dish
that doesn't need much preparation.
Basically, it's a gratin made with sea bream braised in white wine
and spinach.
The trick is to make the sauce with the liquid the fish cooked in.
Well, that's common knowledge."
Yamato: "It looks delicious..."
Aurelie: "And I'm pretty proud of this one too.
It's called petite marmite. The meat
has simmered for quite a while, so it'll melt in your mouth.
And of course, the key to this dish is the soup.
I strained it carefully, so it's clear, see? But don't worry,
it's still full of flavor from the meat and vegetables.
The trick is to simmer the soup with vegetables in a separate pot first.
That keeps the straining to remove scum from the meat to a minimum,
and above all, it gives it a smoother flavor."
Yamato: "Is that what they call pot-au-feu?"
Aurelie: "That's right. You know your stuff.
Petite marmite means 'little pot.'
You serve it out into portions like this.
It's normally a winter dish, but that's all right, isn't it?"
Touya: "I don't mind. But this is impressive.
You made all this in the time you had?"
Aurelie: "Quick and tasty is the basic rule
of home cooking. Well, the petite marmite
did take a little longer.
I thought about doing a full-course meal, but I figured
you'd prefer this... What do you think?"
I definitely prefer this.
A proper full-course meal is tempting too.
Aurelie: "Really? I'm glad..."
Aurelie: "Huh...? Would you have preferred that?"
Touya: "Still, this isn't bad either."
Aurelie: "I'm glad to hear you say that."
Touya: "Now we just have to see how it tastes..."
Aurelie: "Oh, sorry. I've done nothing but explain.
Go ahead. Here, Yamato, you too."
Touya: "Thanks for the food..."
Aurelie: "W-Well? How is it?"
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "Huh? No way. Is it bad?"
Touya: "...It's delicious."
Aurelie: "Really?"
Touya: "Yeah. I've never had anything like this before,
but this is really something. Yeah, it's good. Right?"
Yamato: "..."
Aurelie: "Huh? What's wrong?"
Yamato: "...It's too hot to eat..."
Aurelie: "Oh, sorry. Of course.
All right, I'll blow on it for you."
Yamato: "Huh? Oh, thank you..."
Aurelie: "What would you like? Fish, I suppose?"
Yamato: "Yes, the sea bream, please..."
Touya: "Whew... It's hot..."
Aurelie: "Have you had enough? I could make some pilaf
with what I have on hand if you're still hungry..."
Touya: "No, I'm stuffed. Cheese really fills you up.
And my stomach's sloshing with soup."
Aurelie: "Well? Do you believe
what I told you now?"
Touya: "Yeah. You'll make a good wife."
Aurelie: "Y-You think so...?"
Touya: "I'm jealous of whoever gets to eat
your cooking every day."
Aurelie: "W-Well, I'd better start clearing up..."
Touya: "Huh? R-Right... Then we should..."
Aurelie: "It's fine. You're my guests today.
Leave the rest to me."
Touya: "I-I see..."
Yamato: "Well, Aurelie, thank you for today.
That was delicious."
Aurelie: "I'm glad you liked it. It was worth making.
Should I call you next time I cook too?"
Touya: "Yeah, we'd love that anytime. See you."
Aurelie: "Okay. See you."
